utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the power cable now and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — it’s still on today. I’m checking the power cable now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’m still sorting the pickup list and volunteer coverage, so I’m trying to keep the logistics tight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help keep it tight and reach out to folks to fill any gaps. Just send me the pickup list and where you still need volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’ll send the pickup list and the gaps, and I’ll keep you posted on any changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep building the list and match each repair with the right neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Rosa — I’ll keep tracking the needs and who can handle each one. Let’s make sure we’ve got the list ready for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll organize the current list and keep matching each repair with the right neighbors, so we’re ready for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll bring the list and a couple boxes for sorting. Just let me know if there’s anything else you need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — I’m bringing the tools, trash bags, and my lamp. Just tell me where to drop everything off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll set the list and boxes by the drop-off spot. Where should I put them when I get there?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m out running errands now, and I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — keep an ear out, and I’ll make sure the repair drive plan gets around clearly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll let you know if I hear anything while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The community center is best, thanks — I’ll make sure it gets to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Uli — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep an ear out and let folks know the repair drive is still on today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate you spreading the word. If anyone asks, tell them the community center is the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still only hearing bits and pieces, but I think it starts in the afternoon. I’ll check around and let you know what they want people to bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell. If you can, let me know the time and what items they need, and I’ll make a simple list so we’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I will—I’m going to ask around and confirm the time and supplies, then I’ll send you the list once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—send me the task list when it’s ready, and I’ll help round up the right neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll send it over, and I can lend a few tools if the list calls for them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, Gus — I’ll look for your tools on the list. If you know any neighbors who can pitch in, send their names too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Dane — I’m checking the details first. What’s the next thing you need me to confirm for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Just confirm the starter fixes list — leaky faucets, loose outlets, and squeaky doors. If there’s space, I’ll swing by a bit late and help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ve got the starter fixes list: leaky faucets, loose outlets, and squeaky doors. If you can come late, that’d be great; I’ll check the space and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll keep a running list. If you can think of any spare parts, send them my way and I’ll organize the rest.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll send over any spare parts I hear about, and I’ll keep tracking the repair drive locations too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Opal — I’ll keep the supplies list updated and match it with the locations. Just send anything you hear, and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—I’ll plan on 10 to 12 this Saturday and check for any school conflicts. If anything comes up, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — that sounds good to me. I’m still a bit scattered on the details, so I’ll be glad to hear if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye on the school schedule and send you a quick update if anything shifts. For now, let’s hold Saturday from 10 to 12.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and send anyone who asks your way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. I’ll keep gathering tools and fasteners, and I’ll wait on the spare parts list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll let folks know to bring any tools, and I’ll send anyone asking about the parts list your way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — let’s get the basics covered first. Tell me what Tess still needs, and I’ll keep track of the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep you posted as folks arrive and I hear what’s still needed. Gus has already offered some tools, so I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll note Gus’s tools and keep the list updated as you hear more.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’m out running errands now, and I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — keep me posted if you hear any more location details for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear any location details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ve got the list and a couple boxes for sorting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — that helps a lot. I’ll keep asking around and let you know if I hear what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — I’ll wait to hear back from you. If you find out anything else they need, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that, Gus—just tell me what still needs doing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — I’ve got a drill, hammer, tape measure, and a few screwdrivers if those would help. I’ll be home after 4, so you can swing by anytime.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s perfect, Gus—thanks. I’ll stop by after 4 and we can get started.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and point anyone asking your way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I really appreciate you spreading the word and sending folks my way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll keep an ear out and send anyone who asks your way right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That still works on my end—I’ll double-check the school calendar and let you know if anything conflicts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye—that sounds good. Just let me know as soon as you check, and I’ll keep the rest of the plan simple.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll check the school calendar today and let you know right away if anything conflicts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I can bring the hand tools and the lamp. Just tell me where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — drop them off at my place, and I’ll sort them with the rest. If you can, swing by around 3:00 PM.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll drop them off at your place around 3:00 PM. Thanks for coordinating it!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — could you tell me what the first repair-drive task is? I want to check the details before we start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We should start with the pickup list and make sure we’ve got enough volunteers for loading and delivery.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Pia — I’ll check the pickup list and volunteer count first. Could you send me the current list so I can review it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still on board — if you’ve got a spot for me, I can take a pass at the leaky faucets or squeaky doors when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — I’ll put you on faucets and doors. If you want, I can also pair you with a neighbor for the heavier stuff.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that works for me — I’ll handle faucets and doors, and I’m happy to team up if there’s anything heavier by the time I show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I’m still a bit fuzzy on the latest, but I think they’re collecting supplies and tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I can help spread the word and point folks to the signup info for supplies and tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — that’d be a huge help. I’m still a little fuzzy on the exact list, so I’ll pass along what I know and let you know if I catch more.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll keep the list going and track who needs what. Leo, do you want to help with outreach or bring any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with outreach, and I’ll bring my basic tool kit too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo — outreach and a toolkit both help a lot. I’ll keep you on the list and we’ll use you for whatever comes up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s still on today, and I’m keeping everything organized. I’ll confirm the next locations and tasks as we go.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — thanks for confirming. I’ll keep an eye out for people arriving.
